reasons.fixture-git: The assertion consumes a ref, status, file or operation on the repository arranged for this test.
reasons.fixture-db: The assertion consumes application state or a result obtained with this case’s schema, seed, store or service.
reasons.fixture-io: The assertion consumes the contents, existence or layout of test-arranged files or an operation on them.
reasons.fixture-data: The tracked sample is test data for the parser, projection, replay or runtime invocation.
reasons.child: The checkout identifies the executable, script, probe or working directory. The assertion consumes its behavior with case inputs.
reasons.product: The assertion consumes a product result for the declared scenario. The source path match supplies no independent checkout assertion.
reasons.diagnostic: Checkout lookup supplies the location or provenance for this run’s diagnostic output.
reasons.live: The result depends on a live provider, PTY, OS or application observation under its existing admission.
